confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge and the supplied comparables, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant and budget anchors are the best grounded. Draught beer and the three-star room are less certain given wide Jakarta price variation by district and venue. Cocktail and wine were not based on direct price knowledge and were set relative to the beer anchor using typical bar pricing.
comparable_city_reasoning: Primary basis is Yogyakarta, Indonesia (same national price environment), adjusted upward for Jakarta's larger metro cost level and more upscale hotel and restaurant supply. Chiang Mai and Vientiane serve as regional cross-checks for the mid-range meal and hotel tiers.
